headline: K. Mitsotakis: “We Feel Vindicated by the Integration of OPEKEPE into AADE – Technology for the Benefit of Producers”
summary: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis said the integration of OPEKEPE into AADE, using a new technology platform, benefits producers. He encouraged farmers to learn about the platform.
why: OPEKEPE administers EU agricultural subsidy payments in Greece, and AADE is the national tax and customs authority, so the transfer changes how farm payments are administered.
